name: CholecSeg8k
description: A semantic segmentation dataset of 8,080 laparoscopic cholecystectomy frames from 17 Cholec80 videos, with pixel-level annotations for 13 classes.
citation: Hong et al., CholecSeg8k: A Semantic Segmentation Dataset for Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Based on Cholec80, arXiv:2012.12453 (2020). https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.12453

license.notes: The arXiv abstract states that CholecSeg8k is released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
